description: This PHP source file implements SOAP web service endpoints for the SuiteCRM portal user functionalities, including user login, session validation, logout, retrieving and updating records, and managing notes and subscriptions. It serves as the server-side SOAP API for portal modules and user interactions.

methods.name: portal_login
methods.description: Authenticates a portal user and initiates a session, returning session ID or error info.

methods.name: portal_validate_authenticated
methods.description: Validates an existing session ID and resumes session if valid.

methods.name: portal_logout
methods.description: Terminates a session given a session ID.

methods.name: portal_get_sugar_id
methods.description: Returns the internal SugarCRM user ID associated with the session.

methods.name: portal_get_sugar_contact_id
methods.description: Returns the contact ID associated with the session.

methods.name: portal_get_entry_list
methods.description: Retrieves a list of entries for a specified module, with optional filters and sorting.

methods.name: portal_get_entry_list_filter
methods.description: Retrieves filtered entry list based on dynamic criteria.

methods.name: portal_get_entry
methods.description: Fetches a specific record by ID within a module.

methods.name: portal_set_entry
methods.description: Creates or updates a record in a specified module.

methods.name: portal_set_note_attachment
methods.description: Uploads and attaches a note file to a note record.

methods.name: portal_remove_note_attachment
methods.description: Removes a note attachment by ID.

methods.name: portal_get_note_attachment
methods.description: Retrieves a note attachment file content.

methods.name: portal_relate_note_to_module
methods.description: Links a note to another module record.

methods.name: portal_get_related_notes
methods.description: Returns notes related to a specific module record.

methods.name: portal_get_related_list
methods.description: Retrieves related records from a specified module relationship.

methods.name: portal_get_module_fields
methods.description: Returns the fields for a specified module.

methods.name: portal_get_subscription_lists
methods.description: Returns the mailing list subscription status for the user.

methods.name: portal_set_newsletters
methods.description: Subscribes or unsubscribes the user to mailing lists.
